item.title: Kimi Integrates with Gmail, Drive, and Calendar for Task Automation
item.description:
Moonshot AI announced that Kimi has integrated with Google's ecosystem, enabling users to access Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar via plugins. This update allows users to summarize email threads, search cloud files, and plan daily schedules, with all operations secured through OAuth authorization.

原文标题：Kimi 接入 Gmail、Drive 与日历 支持邮件总结与日程规划

Why it matters：主流大模型应用扩展办公场景连接能力，提升个人生产力工具实用性。

item.title: Huawei Clarifies No Drug R&D, Targets AI Pharma Infrastructure
item.description:
Huawei's Pharmaceutical Legion President Fan Jie clarified that Huawei will not engage in direct drug development but aims to serve as the technical infrastructure backbone for the AI pharma industry. Leveraging advantages in advanced computing power, cluster interconnectivity, and ecosystem synergy, Huawei provides foundational support to pharmaceutical companies and research institutions, with some projects already deploying hundred-card computing clusters.

原文标题：华为明确不做药，定位 AI 制药算力底座

Why it matters：明确了科技巨头在垂直领域的边界与战略定位，涉及大规模算力集群在特定行业的落地实践。

item.title: DOJ Probes Nvidia's Hugging Face Acquisition and CUDA Monopoly Risks
item.description:
The US DOJ is scrutinizing Nvidia's $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, fearing control over a key AI distribution hub could harm competition. Regulators are also investigating Nvidia's sales practices, cloud investments, and ecosystem lock-in risks associated with its CUDA software.

原文标题：美司法部调查 Nvidia 收购 Hugging Face 及 CUDA 垄断嫌疑

Why it matters：涉及 AI 基础设施巨头与核心开源社区的并购监管，直接影响开发者生态与算力市场格局。

item.title: Anthropic Files for IPO with Valuation Up to $2 Trillion
item.description:
Frontier AI lab Anthropic has filed its S-1 document for a Nasdaq IPO, targeting a valuation between $1.5 and $2 trillion. The filing reveals the complex economics of frontier AI, built on ambitious assumptions about AGI's future impact and massive compute costs, marking a pivotal shift from private funding to public markets.

原文标题：Anthropic 提交 IPO 申请 估值或达 2 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是首家顶级大模型公司冲击万亿级市值的重大商业事件，其 S-1 文件首次深度解构了前沿 AI 实验室的真实经济账本与 AGI 叙事逻辑。

item.title: Alphabet Shares Plunge on Missed Q3 Earnings and AI Cost Concerns
item.description:
Alphabet's shares plunged over 13%, marking its largest single-day drop ever, after Q3 revenue and net income missed market expectations. While Google Cloud revenue doubled, the decline in search advertising and a negative free cash flow driven by $51.4 billion in AI infrastructure capital expenditures intensified investor concerns.

原文标题：Alphabet Q3 财报不及预期 股价创史上最大单日跌幅

Why it matters：该事件揭示了 AI 巨额投入与传统广告收入之间的财务张力，是观察科技巨头 AI 商业化进程的关键节点。

item.title: IBM Releases Granite Switch 4.1.1 with Model Hot-Swapping
item.description:
IBM released Granite Switch 4.1.1, highlighting the ability to 'update models like software' via its modular Switch architecture. This version serves as a patch or incremental update to last week's Granite Switch 4.1, focusing on improved multilingual and punctuation capabilities alongside a new Speech-to-Decisions demo.

原文标题：IBM Granite Switch 4.1.1 发布 支持模型热更新

item.title: Baidu VP Wu Tian Departs; Wenxin Model Updates Expected Next Week
item.description:
Wu Tian, Baidu's Vice President and former head of the foundation model team, has confirmed her departure after a 20-year tenure. Despite this leadership change, Baidu asserts that technical progress continues uninterrupted, with new developments for the Wenxin (ERNIE) model expected next week. This follows the recent open-source release of Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 and upcoming announcements at the Baidu World conference.

原文标题：百度副总裁吴甜离职，文心模型下周将发新进展

Why it matters：头部大厂核心 AI 高管离职伴随重大产品迭代预告，反映组织调整与业务节奏的关联，值得行业关注。

item.title: Anthropic S-1 Reveals Massive Revenue Growth and Compute Dependency
item.description:
Anthropic's first public filing (S-1) reveals a 14x year-over-year revenue growth to $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026, yet highlights significant fixed cost pressures. The business model relies heavily on aggressive compute spending and potential recursive self-improvement; without achieving automation beyond human supervision, meeting compute commitments and profitability remains challenging.

原文标题：Anthropic S-1 披露营收暴增 依赖算力投入与自我改进

Why it matters：深度解析头部 AI 实验室财务模型与技术路线之间的强耦合关系，揭示高增长背后的结构性风险。

item.title: Chinese AI Labs Shift Distillation Target to OpenAI's Astra as Anthropic Tightens Defenses
item.description:
As Anthropic strengthens defenses around Claude's reasoning outputs, Chinese AI labs like DeepSeek and Moonshot AI have shifted their primary distillation target to OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. These entities leveraged Astra's outputs to train models such as Kimi K3.1 Pro, despite prohibitions on extracting hidden reasoning steps, with attackers continuously adapting tactics to bypass new security measures.

原文标题：Anthropic 防御升级后，中国 AI 实验室转向蒸馏 OpenAI Astra

Why it matters：揭示了前沿大模型在商业竞争中的知识转移动态及安全对抗现状，对理解开源/闭源生态博弈具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Deepgram Acquires Pipecat Maker Daily to Strengthen Voice AI Infrastructure
item.description:
Voice AI firm Deepgram has acquired Daily, the developer of the popular open-source framework Pipecat, aiming to consolidate real-time voice and video infrastructure capabilities. While the deal amount remains undisclosed, both companies committed to keeping Pipecat open-source. This move highlights the accelerating consolidation within the voice AI infrastructure sector.

原文标题：Deepgram 收购 Pipecat 开发商 Daily 强化语音 AI 基础设施

Why it matters：头部语音 AI 厂商通过并购整合关键开源基础设施，标志着该领域从单点技术竞争转向全栈生态构建。

item.title: Amazon Adds 100+ Shopping Features to Alexa for Subscriptions and Delivery
item.description:
Amazon has introduced over 100 new shopping capabilities to Alexa, focusing on list management, subscription handling, and delivery instruction updates. While the company highlights significant growth in agentic feature usage, this update represents routine functional iteration within e-commerce scenarios rather than a breakthrough in underlying AI technology.

item.description:
Google's newly released Gemini 4 Carbon has secured the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with a score of 59. The model demonstrates leading performance in complex reasoning, knowledge, and scientific tasks, alongside significant improvements in coding capabilities compared to previous Gemini versions.

item.title: Experts Call for Real-Time Observability of AI Agents
item.description:
Experts from the Partnership on AI argue that current deployments of AI agents in critical sectors lack effective real-time monitoring, creating 'flying blind' risks. The article emphasizes the urgent need for observability frameworks to track agent actions and reasoning, preventing unauthorized operations and potential safety disasters.

原文标题：AI 治理专家呼吁建立智能体实时可观测性机制

Why it matters：针对智能体安全与治理的行业观点，虽无技术突破但指出了关键的监管痛点。

item.title: Doubao Work Adds Third-Party Models Including Kimi and DeepSeek
item.description:
ByteDance's 'Doubao Work' has opened third-party LLM services to enterprise clients, initially integrating models from Moonshot (Kimi), Zhipu (GLM), and DeepSeek. The feature is enabled by default for subscribed teams, utilizing existing AI credits for billing while allowing granular permission controls per department or member.

item.title: Innolight Net Profit Jumps 211% as Optical Module Demand Surges
item.description:
Global optical module leader Innolight reported a 211.81% year-on-year surge in net profit to 22.24 billion yuan for the first three quarters of 2026, with revenue up 178.13%. The significant beat on market expectations is driven by explosive demand for 800G and 1.6T high-speed optical modules from major cloud providers like Google and Microsoft amid the AI infrastructure boom.

item.title: 纽约州立法禁止向未成年人提供不安全 AI 聊天机器人
item.description:
美国纽约州签署新法令，明确禁止向未成年人提供涉及情感依赖、自残诱导或性露骨内容的“不安全”AI聊天机器人服务。该法律强制企业实施年龄验证机制并规定数据删除义务，违者将面临高额民事罚款及模型销毁等严厉救济措施。

Why it matters：这是美国首个针对AI伴侣类应用未成年人保护的州级强制性合规法案，对AI产品安全设计与数据治理具有风向标意义。

item.title: 新芯航途预告 X9 芯片 2027 年推 算力达 3000 TOPS
item.description:

Why it matters：虽属远期路线图且缺乏具体架构细节，但明确了国产 AI 芯片向高带宽与大算力演进的时间节点与量化目标。

item.description:

item.title: Momenta 预告 R7 Ultra 模型，算力芯片 X7 Ultra 同步亮相
item.description:

item.description:
